description: Single source of truth for every pinned test fixture input. Local compose runs and GitHub Actions both build from these values. No moving tag is permitted anywhere.

activemq.rationale: Officially maintained Apache image. It replaces the abandoned upstream fixture image whose only tag was last pushed 2023-01-10.

activemq-proxy.rationale: A plain TCP relay in front of ActiveMQ, so that a recovery case can hold one address across a real broker restart. Compose publishes an ephemeral loopback port per container start, so a restarted broker returns on a different port every time and no client could reconnect to the address it was given; the proxy is never restarted and the broker behind it really goes away. Official Docker library image, 3.4 is the current stable line and carries the lts tag, GPLv2 with the LGPL runtime exception, and the manifest list covers linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 so the same digest serves the CI runner and a developer machine. The digest is the manifest list, not one architecture.

artemis.rationale: Artemis is a second, separate broker used by the parameterized 'artemis' flavor of a subset of the ActiveMQ specs. It is not the ViciOne fixture and is not a required gate. It is pinned here so the branch has a reproducible endpoint instead of the hardcoded port 61618 with admin/admin it carried from the imported baseline.

mssql.rationale: SQL Server for the Entity Framework specs. The imported baseline ran them on ubuntu with exactly this image as a service container, so the 'LocalDb' in the provider name is a misnomer: its first two candidates are a Linux SQL Server, not Windows LocalDB. The tag is pinned by digest because 'latest' is a moving target.

postgres.rationale: PostgreSQL for the Entity Framework specs. The imported baseline used postgres:14.7; 16 is the current supported line and the specs use no version specific behaviour.

rabbitmq.rationale: Official Docker library image. The management plugin is required because the test set up creates and cleans the 'test' virtual host over the HTTP API on port 15672.

rabbitmq_delayed_message_exchange.rationale: Community plugin, not part of the official image. Fifteen call sites use UseDelayedMessageScheduler and six declare x-delayed exchange arguments, so the tests cannot run without it. Built against RabbitMQ server 4.2.0, matching the pinned base.

publication.rationale: This slice publishes no image. Both fixtures are built from the pinned bases during the run, identically for local compose and CI.
